CompositeOT.regularizers¶

Regularizers and proximal modules for CompositeOT.

The paper uses the same proximal interface for the four model terms R(X), h(D), p_r(y), and p_c(z). The concrete regularizers live in small per-regularizer modules; this package re-exports the public API so from CompositeOT.regularizers import ... remains stable.
